scheme_name: ICAR Junior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
description:
The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is a prestigious scheme initiated by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) to support post-graduate studies in agricultural sciences. 

This scheme was launched in 1979 to promote research and development in the agricultural sector. 

The primary objective of the ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is to provide financial assistance to students pursuing a Master's degree in agricultural sciences. 

The fellowship aims to enhance the quality of research in agriculture by attracting talented students into the field. 

The scheme also seeks to develop human resources in agriculture that are capable of addressing the challenges faced by the sector. 

The fellowship is awarded to candidates who qualify through the All India Competitive Examination conducted by ICAR. 

Each year, ICAR conducts this examination to select eligible candidates for the fellowship. 

The fellowship amount is set at INR 31,000 per month for the first two years. 

For the third year, the fellowship amount increases to INR 35,000 per month. 

In addition to the monthly stipend, the fellowship also provides a contingency grant of INR 10,000 per annum. 

This grant is intended to cover expenses related to research activities. 

The total duration of the fellowship is three years, contingent upon satisfactory progress in the research work. 

Candidates must meet specific eligibility criteria to apply for the fellowship. 

Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in agricultural sciences or a related field from a recognized university. 

The minimum age limit for applicants is 19 years. 

There is no upper age limit for candidates applying for the fellowship. 

Candidates must also have a valid score in the ICAR AIEEA PG examination. 

This examination is typically conducted in the month of June every year. 

The application process for the ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is conducted online. 

Candidates must register on the official ICAR website to access the application form. 

The application form requires candidates to provide personal details, educational qualifications, and research interests. 

Candidates must also upload scanned copies of relevant documents. 

These documents include educational certificates, identity proof, and photographs. 

The application fee for the examination is INR 1,500 for general candidates. 

For SC/ST candidates, the fee is reduced to INR 750. 

Once the applications are submitted, candidates receive an admit card for the examination. 

The examination consists of multiple-choice questions covering various subjects in agricultural sciences. 

The results of the examination are typically announced within a month of the test date. 

Successful candidates are then called for counseling sessions conducted by ICAR. 

During counseling, candidates are allocated research institutes based on their ranks and preferences. 

The fellowship is implemented by the ICAR through its various research institutes and agricultural universities across India. 

These institutes play a crucial role in mentoring and guiding fellows during their research work. 

The fellowship is an essential component of India's efforts to strengthen agricultural research and education. 

It aligns with the government's broader goals of enhancing food security and improving agricultural productivity. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship has contributed significantly to the development of skilled professionals in the agricultural sector. 

Over the years, thousands of students have benefited from this scheme. 

The fellowship has also led to numerous research projects that have advanced agricultural practices in India. 

In recent years, the ICAR has emphasized the importance of innovation in agricultural research. 

The fellowship encourages research that addresses contemporary challenges such as climate change and sustainable farming practices. 

The ICAR also collaborates with international organizations to enhance the scope of research funded by the fellowship. 

This collaboration helps in knowledge exchange and capacity building in agricultural research. 

The fellowship has a significant impact on the career trajectories of its recipients. 

Many former fellows have gone on to hold prestigious positions in academia, research, and government. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is a vital tool for fostering research excellence in agricultural sciences. 

It not only provides financial support but also creates a community of researchers dedicated to agricultural advancement. 

The scheme is regularly reviewed and updated to meet the evolving needs of the agricultural sector. 

In 2023, the ICAR announced plans to increase the number of fellowships awarded annually. 

This decision aims to accommodate the growing interest in agricultural research among students. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is a testament to India's commitment to enhancing agricultural education and research. 

It plays a crucial role in shaping the future of agriculture in the country. 

The fellowship not only supports individual researchers but also contributes to national agricultural goals. 

Through this scheme, the ICAR aims to build a robust research ecosystem that can drive innovation in agriculture. 

The fellowship is an excellent opportunity for students passionate about making a difference in the agricultural sector. 

It provides a platform for young researchers to contribute to significant agricultural challenges. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is a beacon of hope for aspiring agricultural scientists in India. 

It empowers them to pursue their research interests and make meaningful contributions to society. 

The fellowship is a vital investment in the future of agriculture in India. 

It ensures that the next generation of agricultural scientists is well-equipped to tackle the challenges ahead. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship continues to inspire and nurture talent in agricultural research. 

This scheme is a crucial part of India's strategy to enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability. 

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting education and research in agriculture. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is more than just financial assistance; it is an opportunity for growth and innovation. 

It is a stepping stone for many students towards a successful career in agricultural sciences. 

The fellowship embodies the spirit of research and development in India's agricultural landscape. 

Through this scheme, the ICAR aims to create a future where agriculture thrives through research-driven solutions. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is a cornerstone of agricultural education and research in India. 

It is essential for nurturing the next generation of leaders in the agricultural sector. 

The fellowship is a vital resource for those looking to make a significant impact in agricultural sciences. 

It is a program that continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of the agricultural community. 

The ICAR Junior Research Fellowship is a significant contributor to the advancement of agricultural research in India. 

It is a program that empowers students to pursue their dreams and contribute to the nation's agricultural development.
